label: B25-RXCPU-LOGIC-IMM-SYNTHESIS-REPAIR-BATCH
title: Prove and repair the Quartus-visible logical-immediate divergence exposed by T-021
trigger: T-021 proved dmem response 0x0000A43F at bridge/PoC/core taps while uart_getc took TBNZ bit15 but both following logical-immediate masks behaved as zero; T-017 Quartus synthesis reported warning 16788 for lcvex_decode.sv logical-immediate temporary imm[63].
hypothesis: Quartus 21.4 mis-synthesizes the output-argument form of logic_imm_valid or leaves part of its local imm value undriven. This must be proven against the exact two firmware opcodes before changing unrelated dmem/writeback logic.

batch_contract.test_lane: T-023 owns only new synthesis-equivalence test/project files and must capture an old-SHA negative control.
batch_contract.rtl_lane: T-024 owns only rtl/lcvex_decode.sv and rewrites the logical-immediate valid/mask expression without changing ISA semantics.
batch_contract.integration: The integrator serially merges both lanes into one candidate, registers any common test entry, then reruns the directed old/new contract and affected L0-L2 on the merged SHA.
batch_contract.physical_boundary: No fresh Quartus full physical flow, assembler or board action begins until the merged candidate proves the two opcodes and removes the synthesis warning without regressions.

acceptance: Old base 1ce74e9c has a reproducible Quartus-visible negative control tied to warning 16788 and/or wrong post-map behavior, not merely a speculative code smell.
Opcode 0x12003C06 with W0=0xA43F yields W6=0xA43F; opcode 0x12001C00 yields W0=0x3F in behavioral and Quartus-produced logic.
The new implementation has no output-argument/local undriven logical-immediate temporary and fresh synthesis emits no warning 16788 for this cone.
All valid 32/64-bit logical-immediate encodings retain reference mask semantics; reserved encodings remain UDEF.
Affected L0-L2, boot image identity and full behavioral SoC RXCPU expectations pass on one frozen merged SHA.
resource: Local generated tests use the local heavy lock when applicable; GamePC Quartus probes use gamepc. The two resource slots may overlap only with isolated inputs/outputs. Monitoring is event-driven with waits up to one hour.
forbidden_regions: guessing a dmem/writeback fix before the logical-immediate hypothesis is falsified
waiving or filtering Quartus warning 16788 instead of eliminating its cause
changing expected architectural results, disabling assertions or skipping negative encodings
assembler, JTAG, FPGA configuration, JIC/EPCQ/Flash, reset or power actions

dispatch.monitoring: event-driven, up to one-hour waits, no frequent polling

result.root_cause: Quartus 21.4 warning 16788 on the logical-immediate output-argument temporary is eliminated by a pure fully-assigned packed return; this matches the T-021 physical A43F/TBNZ/zero-mask symptom.
result.old_negative: PASS; fresh old RTL synthesis reproduced warning 16788
result.fixed_synthesis: PASS; fresh candidate synthesis Successful/0 errors and warning 16788 count 0
result.exhaustive: PASS; 16384 encodings, 11328 legal and 5056 reserved, exact A43F/3F cases
result.affected_l0_l2: PASS; compile, SV smoke, microbench, encoders, M20K timing, RX response trace and vendor full-SoC CAL-OK/WAIT/FAIL
result.postmap_limit: EDA netlist generated, but no compatible simulator/vendor primitive model was available; no post-map semantic PASS is claimed
